policy.objective: Maintain a curated, source-backed discovery backlog for genuinely new FinFlow Track educational articles.
policy.selection: A topic is eligible only when its source pack is active, fresh complete Google Search Console query evidence meets the daily portfolio threshold, intent is compatible, and inventory/cannibalization/originality checks pass.
policy.noDemandGuarantee: Backlog membership is not evidence of search demand. Never generate a draft or claim search volume from a backlog entry alone.
policy.geography: Global educational audience. Government guidance must remain explicitly scoped to its jurisdiction.
policy.review: Every draft requires human fact, source relevance, originality, product-claim and editorial review before publication.

topics.title: How to Reconcile a Business Bank Statement: A Monthly Checklist
queryPatterns: how to reconcile a business bank statement
how to reconcile business bank account
topics.angle: Practical reconciliation workflow, timing differences, source documents and monthly review; avoid tax or legal conclusions.
topics.jurisdiction: United States examples only; clearly distinguish local requirements elsewhere.
topics.gscGate: At least 10 fresh query impressions with complete clicks, CTR and average-position fields.

topics.title: Cash vs. Accrual Accounting: How the Methods Differ

topics.angle: Explain recognition timing and why profit and cash can differ; explicitly scope all tax-method rules to US IRS guidance.
topics.jurisdiction: United States federal tax-method overview only; never imply that IRS eligibility rules apply globally.
topics.gscGate: At least 10 fresh query impressions with complete clicks, CTR and average-position fields.
